import { gsap } from 'gsap';

    DirectionalLight, HemisphereLight, AmbientLight, Color,

  const SURFACE = colors.surface ?? '#16161d';       // color.surface / color.ink
  const PAPER = colors.paper ?? '#e8ecf2';           // color.paper
  const ACCENT = colors.accent ?? '#ff2a38';         // color.accent

  const timelines = [];

  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();

    const cBg = vec3(...new Color(BG).toArray());
    const cTop = vec3(...new Color(G0).toArray());
    const cBot = vec3(...new Color(G1).toArray());
    // vertical gradient between the two stops, feathered into background at edges
    const grad = mix(cBot, cTop, v);
    const edge = smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, uv().x).mul(smoothstep(1.0, 0.65, uv().x));

  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);

      const idx = r * COLS + c;
      const mark = marks[idx];
      if (!mark) continue;

      const tileGroup = new Group();
      const x = -gridW / 2 + TILE_W / 2 + c * (TILE_W + GAP);
      const y = gridH / 2 - TILE_H / 2 - r * (TILE_H + GAP);
      tileGroup.position.set(x, y, 0);

      const mat = makeTileMaterial();
      disposables.push(mat);
      const mesh = new Mesh(tileGeo, mat);
      mesh.scale.setScalar(1); // chamfer approximated by inset box + clearcoat edge read
      tileGroup.add(mesh);

      // wordmark: flat monochrome paper at 78% opacity, mono caps
      const label = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(String(mark.text), {
        fontSize: mark.typography?.fontSize ?? 13,
        color: PAPER,
        align: 'center',
        letterSpacingPx: 1.0,
      });
      label.position.set(0, 0, 0.04);
      if (label.material) label.material.transparent = true;
      tileGroup.add(label);

      // mount state
      tileGroup.position.y = y + 0.2;
      setOpacity(tileGroup, 0);

      group.add(tileGroup);
      tiles.push({ tileGroup, mesh, label, baseY: y, idx });
    }
  }

  function setOpacity(obj, value) {
    obj.traverse((o) => {
      if (o.material) {
        o.material.transparent = true;
        o.material.opacity = o.userData._baseOp !== undefined
          ? o.userData._baseOp * value : value;
      }
    });
  }

  // wordmark base opacity 0.78
  for (const t of tiles) {
    t.label.traverse((o) => { if (o.material) o.userData._baseOp = 0.78; });
    t.mesh.userData._baseOp = 1;
  }

  // ---------- kickerBlock: kicker + accent tick above the grid ----------
  const kickerY = gridH / 2 + 0.3;
  const kicker = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(String(kickerItem?.text ?? 'AS FEATURED IN'), {
    fontSize: kickerItem?.typography?.fontSize ?? 9,
    color: PAPER,
    align: 'center',
    letterSpacingPx: 1.1,
  });
  kicker.position.set(0, kickerY, 0);
  group.add(kicker);

  const tickGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.22, 0.02);
  const tickMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  tickMat.colorNode = vec3(...new Color(ACCENT).toArray()); // single red accent, <10% frame
  const tick = new Mesh(tickGeo, tickMat);
  tick.position.set(0, kickerY - 0.12, 0);
  group.add(tick);
  disposables.push(tickGeo, tickMat);

  // ---------- mountMotion: stagger-cards fade-up, top row L->R ----------
  const mountTl = gsap.timeline();
  tiles.forEach((t, i) => {
    const prox = { v: 0 };
    mountTl.to(t.tileGroup.position, {
      y: t.baseY, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out',
    }, i * 0.08);
    mountTl.to(prox, {
      v: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out',
      onUpdate: () => setOpacity(t.tileGroup, prox.v),
    }, i * 0.08);
    // key-sweep read: subtle rotation settle so anisotropic highlight travels
    mountTl.fromTo(t.tileGroup.rotation, { x: -0.12 }, {
      x: 0, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power4.out',
    }, i * 0.08);
  });
  timelines.push(mountTl);

  // idle: single slow breathing <= 1.5%
  const idleTl = gsap.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1.012, y: 1.012, duration: 4.5, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, ease: 'sine.inOut',
  });
  timelines.push(idleTl);

  // ---------- hoverHandlers: per-tile wordmark 0.78->1.0 + z lift 0.05 / 160ms ----------
  const hoverTls = new Map();
  function hoverTile(t, over) {
    const prev = hoverTls.get(t.idx);
    if (prev) prev.kill();
    const prox = { v: over ? 0 : 1 };
    const tl = gsap.timeline();
    tl.to(t.tileGroup.position, {
      z: over ? 0.05 : 0, duration: 0.16, ease: 'power2.out',
    }, 0);
    tl.to(prox, {
      v: over ? 1 : 0, duration: 0.16, ease: 'power2.out',
      onUpdate: () => {
        const op = 0.78 + 0.22 * prox.v;
        t.label.traverse((o) => { if (o.material) o.material.opacity = op; });
      },
    }, 0);
    hoverTls.set(t.idx, tl);
    timelines.push(tl);
  }

  group.userData.handlers = {
    pointerover: (e) => {
      const hit = tiles.find((t) => e?.object && (t.mesh === e.object || t.tileGroup === e.object.parent));
      if (hit) hoverTile(hit, true);
    },
    pointerout: (e) => {
      const hit = tiles.find((t) => e?.object && (t.mesh === e.object || t.tileGroup === e.object.parent));
      if (hit) hoverTile(hit, false);
    },
  };

  // ---------- cinematic primitives (spec ships none; apply defensively) ----------
  for (const p of config.cinematicPrimitives ?? []) {
    const fn = ctx.primitives[p.name];
    if (fn) primitiveHandles.push(fn(group, p.params));
  }

  // ---------- cleanup ----------
  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    for (const tl of timelines) tl.kill();
    for (const h of primitiveHandles) h?.cleanup?.();
    for (const [, tl] of hoverTls) tl.kill();
    for (const d of disposables) d.dispose?.();
    group.traverse((o) => {
      if (o.geometry && !disposables.includes(o.geometry)) o.geometry.dispose?.();
      if (o.material && !disposables.includes(o.material)) o.material.dispose?.();
    });
  };

  return group;
}
